title: NRLMSISE-00 Atmosphere Model
text: Implement mathematical representation of 2001 United States Naval Research Laboratory Mass Spectrometer and Incoherent Scatter Radar Exosphere, 9 inputs, 2 outputs, {Action for out-of-range input} sets Out-of-range block behavior; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Input local apparent solar time} sets the apparent solar time, {Input flux and magnetic index information} sets the daily F10.7 flux for previous day and magnetic index, {Source for flags} sets the variation flag source, {Flags} sets the variation flags ones and {Include anomalous oxygen number density in total mass density} sets the anomalous oxygen. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Geodetic latitudes, longitude, and altitude three-element matrix
